items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Nelson' in the context of other musicians but does not explicitly state a personal relationship with Louis Nelson. The statement 'I worked with him' is spoken by the [INTERVIEWER], not the [INTERVIEWEE].

ctx.x: Do you remember the names of any of the other men over there on the different instruments?
Well, uh... Clounce... Clounce... Nelson... He was one of the greatest violin... Jazz violin that, uh... In that time... You know... Play. And he was really a jazz violin player.
